extracted.intended_audience: researchers, association staff, NGO practitioners, and members of the public seeking organizational profile/contact information
extracted.subtask_description: Viewing an Open Yearbook profile entry for an international non-profit (China International Public Relations Association) that provides basic public metadata and indicates which fields/details require a paid subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: UIA Terms of Use — permitted internal use only
rubrics_metrics.description: UIA allows users to access and make use of the information contained in its Databases for the user’s internal use and evaluation purposes only. A user may not re-package, compile, re-distribute or re-use any or all of the UIA Databases or the data* contained therein without prior permission from the UIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a licensing/provenance requirement: data is available for internal evaluation only and any re-use, re-packaging, compilation or redistribution requires prior permission from UIA. The page explicitly defines 'Data' to include raw data, numbers, images, names and contact information, logos, text, keywords, and links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data extraction and bulk-download prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from database resources may not be extracted or downloaded in bulk using automated scripts or other external software tools not provided within the database resources themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a research project will involve extraction of large amounts of text or data, the user must contact UIA for a customized solution. UIA reserves the right to block access for abusive use of the Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Yearbook content limitation and subscription access
rubrics_metrics.description: This information is part of the Open Yearbook, a free service of UIA's subscription-based Yearbook of International Organizations (YBIO). The information contained in the profiles and search functionality of this free service are limited. The full-featured Yearbook includes over 77,500 organization profiles, additional information in the profiles, sophisticated search functionality and data export. More detailed data available with paid subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many profile fields are marked 'Available with paid subscription only' (e.g., History, Activities, Consultative Status, Type I Classification). Users looking for full details, exportable data, or extended search functionality must purchase a subscription or contact UIA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject classification methodology and SDG linkage
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject classification is derived from the organization names and aims. UN SDGs are linked to the subject classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The profile shows subject tags (e.g., Communication → Promotion) that are assigned based on the organization's name and stated aims; Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are connected to those subject classifications.
